'''Vayla Sevren''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Major/Legends|Major]] in the [[Thaereian military]]. She commanded the [[Dorumaa Base|base]] on [[Dorumaa]] and led Thaereian forces there during the [[Battle of Dorumaa]]. After the battle, she met with Major [[Ren Terlo]] of the [[Cularin Militia]], to negotiate the base's surrender.<ref name="Decision Cularin" />
